chapter: Bands and musicians around New Orleans
title: The Imperial Band lineup and Big Eye Louis
summary: Members of the Imperial band behind Manuel Perez, including Jimmy Brown, Buddy Johnson's brother and violinist Peter Bocage, then clarinetist Big Eye Louis.
